character: 40 km. Lake Gerardmer, Belle-Epoque architecture, ice skating on frozen lake.
name: Gérardmer
description: 40km of pistes, 12 lifts, centred around the Lac de Gérardmer — a natural lake that freezes in winter for skating and curling. La Mauselaine ski area above the town. Belle Époque village with a casino, cinema, and spa. Known as the 'Pearl of the Vosges'.

suitability.families: Good — lake village, ice skating, curling
